decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 and 1 invite sent [email:4b8793f2], but no key milestone in 6 days, no customer replies, and a no-show at the kickoff [calendar:692edab4] signal low engagement; only 8 days left, so unaided activation is unlikely though not impossible.

draft.subject: Picking up where we left off
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Sorry we missed each other last week — happy to find another time that works better. You've already got your first project set up in Wrenfield and an invite out, which is a good start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting your first few tasks in there is usually the step that makes the rest click.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through that next step with you and answer anything your team has run into.

Best,
Priya
